scope: Checked CPU uint64 scalars, uint alias, exact full-range constants/CLI values, private native interfaces and mixed-width worker captures/results.

semantics.types: Unsigned 64-bit scalars and uint alias. Unconstrained whole-number literals still infer signed int64. No implicit signedness, width or floating conversion.
semantics.literals_and_constants: UInt64Literal preserves full unsigned bits. Constant maps use a signed128 representation that contains every uint64 value; multiplication checks maximum/divisor before evaluating a product that could exceed signed128. Known overflow, underflow, negation and zero divisors diagnosed without compiler UB.
semantics.arithmetic: Add/subtract/multiply zero-extend to unsigned i128, check UINT64_MAX and narrow. All uint64 products fit unsigned128 exactly. Subtraction checks operand order; negation checks zero at the actual operand width.
semantics.division: Guarded native-width i64 unsigned division/remainder, including operands above INT64_MAX. No widened software division.
semantics.entry: Dedicated uint64 C-interface/CLI entry with exact unsigned decimal output. Existing float32/int32/uint32/int64 entry ABI unchanged.
semantics.tasks: Distinct scalar.uint64 layout keys/IDs with 8-byte storage/alignment; signed64 remains distinct. Common continuation planner carries UInt64Literal and checked kernels. Five scalar families and existing float32 tensor values can share captures.
semantics.failure: Child faults retain source 2:3 and become TaskError.Fault/Arithmetic. Recovery can reuse parent tensors and start another group. Root allocation/admission rejection settles existing scheduler/ownership paths.
semantics.remaining: Int64/uint64 tensor arithmetic, reductions/matmul, further numeric formats, conversions and GPU integer arithmetic remain gated. No public foreign-memory/wire ABI or distributed execution.

coverage: 25 by 25 boundary pairs plus 10000 deterministic full-range pairs per operator
independent unsigned128 reference for seven operators
UINT64_MAX and signed64/float64 precision boundaries
UINT64_MAX squared rejected at compile time and faulted dynamically without reference overflow
multiplication around 2^32 and exact (2^32-1)*(2^32+1)
full-range unsigned literals and immutable bindings
constant intermediate overflow/underflow/negation and known zero divisor checks
uint alias and unchanged default signed inference
strict mixed type/width rejection and forged uint64 tensor backend rejection
native forwarding interfaces and exact CLI output
native-width unsigned division/remainder MLIR check
nested/cached workers and owned tensor captures
five scalar families in the same capture signature and each as root result, including UINT64_MAX and INT64_MIN
distinct signed/unsigned64 and signed/unsigned32 task layouts
all six arithmetic worker failures and recovery with parent tensor reuse
uncaught task faults with original source 2:3 and zero live allocations
root admission/allocation rejection and cleanup
static arithmetic failure preserves executable and LLVM output
Metal uint64 rejection retained
previous signed and unsigned CPU/Metal regression

performance: Correctness and shared unsigned width-policy milestone; no measured arithmetic/task speedup claim.
distributed_execution: Not implemented; agreed design-review gate retained.
